10.0.120

.NET MAUI 10.0.120 Release Notes

Release source: 6aca5366139ed0e1cd05cca3e32b6a887d5a8dd0

.NET MAUI 10.0.120 introduces significant improvements across all platforms with focus on quality, performance, and developer experience. This release includes 213 commits with various improvements, bug fixes, and enhancements.

Ai Agents

  • Remove only legacy /review rerun queue and scanner by @kubaflo in #39029

  • Preserve packed-ref access in isolated Vally workspace by @PureWeen in #39025

  • Add /review performance GitHub Agentic Workflow for PR benchmarks by @morning4coffe-dev in #38324

  • Use GPT-6.1 Sol for gh-aw workflows by @kubaflo in #39036

  • Add maintainer-triggered issue regression tracing by @kubaflo in #38710

  • Issue regression tracing: Bound evidence and preflight version gaps by @kubaflo in #39121

  • Add /issue triage agentic workflow for manual issue labels by @kubaflo in #39065

  • Keep /issue triage reports artifact-only while applying real labels by @kubaflo in #39201

  • Expose citation-safe prose to /issue triage by @kubaflo in #39276

  • Add /review gate without replacing full review by @kubaflo in #39189

  • Fix unattended CI-fixer evidence retrieval by @PureWeen in #39237

Animation

  • Fix AnimationManager.Dispose — retained ticker keeps disposed manager and callbacks alive by @HarishwaranVijayakumar in #37639

    🔧 Fixes
    • [leak-scan] AnimationManager.Dispose — retained ticker keeps disposed manager and callbacks alive

Blazor

  • Fix BlazorWebView root component subscriptions on disconnect by @sheiksyedm in #39247

    🔧 Fixes
    • [Android] BlazorWebViewHandler never unsubscribes from RootComponents.CollectionChanged on disconnect, retaining the old MauiContext and finished Activity

  • [Windows] Enable external file drops in BlazorWebView by @danroth27 in #37904

  • Fix problem with null VirtualView in BlazorWebViewHandler on iOS by @JimmyPun610 in #38141

    🔧 Fixes
    • iOS BlazorWebView crash the app sometime

  • Fix for handler leaks by traversing non-IView Shell nodes in DisconnectHandlers() by @BagavathiPerumal in #38022

    🔧 Fixes
    • iOS: DisconnectHandlers() never reaches pages inside a Shell — BlazorWebView/WebViewManager leak permanently when Window.Page is replaced

    🔧 Fixes
    • <a target="_blank"> with image child <img src="data:image"/> causes app crash on Android in MAUI Blazor Hybrid
